interface.longDescription: KleioBase is a research workspace for family historians. It transcribes and translates handwritten records, builds person profiles and family trees from them, and finds duplicates and conflicting facts across your research. Connect your KleioBase account to search your people, records and places, read family trees, timelines and research findings, upload record photos, run AI transcription, review a scan next to what was read, confirm records once you agree, and cite the sources and archives each fact comes from. You choose Read only or Read and write when you connect, and you can disconnect at any time from Settings > Developer in KleioBase.
defaultPrompt: Who were my great-grandparents in KleioBase?
Give me a timeline of Wilhelm Hartmann's life from my KleioBase tree.
Are there any possible duplicate people in my KleioBase research? Don't merge anything.

positive.description: Search for a person and read their close family
positive.prompt: In my KleioBase research, who were Friedrich Hartmann's parents and siblings?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Wilhelm Hartmann and Anna Vogel as his parents and Maria and Karl Hartmann as his siblings, by name and without internal IDs.

positive.prompt: Give me a timeline of Wilhelm Hartmann's life from my tree.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists his birth in Bremen, his immigration through Baltimore and his death in Cincinnati in date order, from the matched person's records.

positive.prompt: Are there any possible duplicate people in my KleioBase research? Don't merge anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the suggested match between Wilhelm Hartmann and Wilhelm Hartman, explains the shared evidence (same name and birthplace Bremen), and makes no merge or match-acceptance call.

positive.description: Process an explicitly requested online record
positive.prompt: Upload this historical record image and transcribe it: https://kleiobase.com/onboarding-samples/english.jpg
positive.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, upload_record, process_record, wait_for_processing, get_record_extraction, get_record_image
positive.expected_behavior: Upload and process only the requested record, wait for completion, then present the scan beside the extraction and ask before confirming it.

positive.prompt: Who in my KleioBase research was born in Bremen, Germany?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the place Bremen and names Wilhelm Hartmann and Wilhelm Hartman as born there, without internal IDs.

negative.prompt: Search FamilySearch for a baptism record of Johann Müller, born 1850 in Bavaria.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call KleioBase. KleioBase only holds the user's own research and cannot search FamilySearch or other archives.

negative.prompt: What does a DNA match of 1,200 cM usually mean about how two people are related?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without calling KleioBase. No research data is needed.

negative.prompt: Translate this German sentence into English: "Er wurde am 3. Mai 1852 in Bremen geboren."
negative.expected_behavior: Translates the sentence directly without calling KleioBase. There is no record image to upload or transcribe.
